Name: Asher
Summary: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, the second by Zilpah, and the father of Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, and Serah.
KeyStory: Asher's tribe later enjoyed rich food and royal delicacies, just as Jacob had blessed him.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Zilpah; Jimnah; Ishuah; Isui; Beriah; Serah
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
